requirements.title: Coarray dummies require coarray actuals with matching VOLATILE attribute presence
requirements.definition: A coarray dummy argument requires a corresponding coarray actual argument, and the actual has VOLATILE exactly in the cases where the dummy has VOLATILE.

requirements.title: Certain array coarray dummies require simply contiguous actual arguments or elements of simply contiguous arrays
requirements.definition: For an array coarray dummy that has CONTIGUOUS or is not assumed shape, the actual argument is required to be simply contiguous or an element of a simply contiguous array.
